subject: Product preview & next steps — lock two windows?
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@quantaflow.ai>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@quantaflow.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Sep 2025 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: Product preview & next steps — lock two windows?

Hi Samir / Elena —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Quick recap from our side and a proposed path forward so we can get the right people on a short product preview (30 min):

Recap (two bullets):
- Primary goals: validate inference performance on your typical 1k-token prompts and review deployment/segmentation needs for staging vs. prod.
- Constraints: security questionnaire outstanding (Elena flagged SOC2 evidence) and a short privacy Q&A for the compliance team.

Suggested next step: 30-minute product preview (high level + Q&A) followed by a technical deep-dive (if helpful) with engineering. To keep calendars simple, can you pick two preferred windows below? I’ll lock one and send invites. All times are ET.

Option A: Tue Sep 23 — 11:00–11:30 ET
Option B: Wed Sep 24 — 15:00–15:30 ET
Option C: Thu Sep 25 — 09:00–09:30 ET

Attendee suggestions from your side: PM (to confirm success criteria), infra/ops (to surface network/KMS needs). From our side, I’ll bring Ben (solutions) and Marissa (CS lead) — short agenda to share once slot locked.

Also attaching a very short checklist we promised: security checklist + a 1-page scope doc. If you’d like, we can push the technical deep-dive to a separate 60-min session the week after.

Thanks — quick preference here will help us lock stakeholders.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
neha@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0194

Attachments: prelim-sow.pdf (1 page preview), security-checklist.xlsx (stub)

Subject: Re: Product preview & next steps — lock two windows?

Neha —

Appreciate the clear recap. Elena and I reviewed internally; both Option A and B work for our core group. A couple of notes:

- Our PM (Priya Desai) prefers afternoon slots; Ben / Marissa, would 15:00 ET on Wed (Option B) be OK for you?
- For the technical deep-dive, we definitely want a short section on latency/cost tradeoffs for batching — I'll invite our infra lead, Javier Morales.
- On security: Elena will start the SOC2 checklist and send a few specifics by EOD tomorrow. Any docs you need beyond the checklist attached?

Quick answer: pick Option B (Wed Sep 24, 15:00–15:30 ET) as primary; Option A as backup. Please send calendar invites and a brief agenda.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Head of Platform Engineering | Quantaflow
samir@quantaflow.ai
+1 617-555-0132

Thanks Samir — locking Wed Sep 24, 15:00–15:30 ET (confirmed). I've sent a calendar invite to the attendees you listed (Priya and Javier included).

Short agenda (30 min):
- 5m introductions + success criteria (Priya)
- 10m product preview: latency/cost and deployment modes (Neha + Ben)
- 10m engineering Q&A (Javier + Ben)
- 5m next steps and mutual action plan (Marissa)

Prep items for the call:
- Elena: SOC2 evidence items — rough list in reply OK
- Samir / Javier: a sample prompt or two (<=1k tokens) and a rough monthly token estimate — that helps us pick quantization/throughput profile before the deep-dive

I attached the 1-page scope doc and the security checklist to this thread (see attachments). If anything else is needed ahead of Wed, flag it and I’ll coordinate.
